# agentic-assistant

An AI assistant panel that acts inside your apps with the user's own permissions.

Keywords: assistant,ai,agent,tools,mcp,sdk,side-panel,approvals,eu,model-port.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-assistant".
- CLI: agentic-assistant summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-assistant mcp, then call summarize_text.
